lead: Cinematic sci-fi film still in deep space, neon magenta and cyan fireworks glow, violet dark.
notes: Mood-only mini images for Zero Space Robo Derby.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen "Zero Space Robo Derby-mini" --model sdxl --max 999, then finish "Zero Space Robo Derby-mini" --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: meet
images.prompt: Space colonists gathered at a big window of a station, watching small ships race outside.

images.name: ships
images.prompt: A small robot spaceship being painted in a cozy hobby workshop on a space station.

images.name: bonfire
images.prompt: An enormous firework bursting in deep space, seen from a station window.

images.name: stage
images.prompt: Small spaceships drifting between floating grey asteroids, bright bolts crossing between them.

images.name: meet-day
images.prompt: A scoreboard of glowing colored lights in a space station hall full of people.

images.name: album
images.prompt: A wall of glowing photographs of fireworks in a dim space station corridor.

images.name: evening
images.prompt: A pilot relaxing with a drink beside a window full of stars after a long day.

images.name: asteroids
images.prompt: A grey asteroid cracking in two, a spray of colorful dust between the halves.

images.name: drift
images.prompt: A small spaceship drifting sideways through space, its thruster glowing softly.

images.name: replay
images.prompt: A glowing screen showing a firework burst, in a dark room on a space station.
